label: My return: gifts - the rules (s.56(2)(x))

params.name: relatives
params.label: s.56(2)(x) Explanation (e): relatives - spouse; brother or sister; brother or sister of the spouse; brother or sister of either parent; any lineal ascendant or descendant; any lineal ascendant or descendant of the spouse; the spouse of any of these; for an HUF, any member

params.name: exempt_occasions
params.label: s.56(2)(x) proviso: on the person's marriage, under a will or by inheritance, in contemplation of the payer's death

params.name: threshold
params.label: s.56(2)(x): taxable when more than this (sums and movable property in the year together, each immovable property alone)

params.name: inadequate_pct
params.label: s.56(2)(x)(b)(B): immovable property bought for less - taxable when the stamp value beats the price by more than the higher of 50,000 and this % of the price

description_nl: 2026-10-07: Who is a relative, which occasions are exempt and the thresholds for gifts taxed as other sources (s.56(2)(x)).
